name: @nodebraid/index
description: A Bun-powered TypeScript monorepo for nodebraid.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run scripts/build-workspaces.ts && bun run build:root && bun run typecheck:self && bun run test && bun run test:browser:self && bun run --cwd examples/app test:browser:self && bun run docs:check:self
scripts.docs:check: bun run --filter '@nodebraid/core' build && bun run docs:check:self
scripts.docs:quick-start: bun run --filter '@nodebraid/core' build && bun run website/examples/quick-start.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:root && bun run scripts/build-workspaces.ts @nodebraid/core @nodebraid/layout-dagre @nodebraid/layout-elk @nodebraid/renderer-svg @nodebraid/adapter-react
scripts.test:browser: bun run scripts/build-workspaces.ts @nodebraid/adapter-react @nodebraid/renderer-svg @nodebraid/plugin-renderer @nodebraid/plugin-interaction @nodebraid/plugin-history && bun run test:browser:self
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun run typecheck:self
scripts.typecheck:self: tsgo --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/diagnostics/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/kernel/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/document/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/canvas-fragment/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/session-api/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/interaction-api/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/port-api/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/renderer-api/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/renderer-svg/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/runtime-cordis/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-command/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-kernel/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-port/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-session/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-renderer/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-interaction/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-duplicate-selection/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-clipboard/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-history/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/preset-basic/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/layout-api/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/layout-dagre/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/layout-elk/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/plugin-layout/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p packages/adapter-react/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit -p examples/app/tsconfig.json && bun run agents:typecheck
scripts.test:browser:self: bun run --filter '@nodebraid/adapter-react' test:browser:self && bun run --filter '@nodebraid/renderer-svg' test:browser:self
scripts.docs:check:self: bun run docs:verify && bun run website/examples/quick-start.ts && bun run docs:build
